note: Schema lines of a register over five pages of two, with the boundaries inside one table (a|a), between a variable's two folded spellings (lankod: Lan, then LanKod) and across tables (a|b). A line is one (table, variable, folded spelling): Alder is one line though it has two segments (type from its latest, char), LanKod is two (Lan, LanKod), Id is two because it is in both tables; a line's period runs from its first start to its last end, across the 2019 gap. A cursor sent to another catalog generation (the base artifact) is stale_cursor, whatever its ref. Fails if a page repeats or skips a line, lines merge across spellings or split across segments, a period or type is not the group's, or the last page carries a cursor.
